precheck.freshness_rule: at launch, re-read /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id on Ubuntu-22.04; require both distro checks to carry that same boot_id and -1 <= time.time() - checked_unix <= 60; identical to validation/coordination/manager99-run-20260913-01/launch.sh lines 11-14
precheck.script:
import json,os,pathlib,time
markers=('arducopter','ardupilot','px4','micro_ros_agent','microxrceagent','prometheus_control','planner_transport_node','roscore','rosmaster','unrealeditor','matlab','cc1plus','g++','bpftrace','run_joint_flight.py','wksim_core.worker','validate_generated_e0_lifecycle.py','pytest','run_e2e.py','first_step_trace_recorder','wksim-native-release-wait','clock_cases','wksim-release-extension-bench','cc1')
found=[]
for p in pathlib.Path('/proc').iterdir():
 if not p.name.isdigit() or int(p.name)==os.getpid():continue
 try:
  comm=(p/'comm').read_text().strip()
  argv=(p/'cmdline').read_bytes().replace(b'\0',b' ').decode(errors='replace')
  if comm in ('bash','sh','dash','timeout'):continue
  if any(m in (comm+' '+argv).lower() for m in markers):
   found.append(dict(pid=int(p.name),comm=comm,argv=argv[:350]))
 except (FileNotFoundError,ProcessLookupError,PermissionError):pass
print(json.dumps(dict(checked_unix=time.time(),distro=os.environ.get('WSL_DISTRO_NAME'),boot_id=pathlib.Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip(),uptime=pathlib.Path('/proc/uptime').read_text().strip(),found=found)))

environment.must_be_unset_reason: WKSIM_JOINT_RATE_TIMING_PROBE/WKSIM_JOINT_CPU_TIMING are separate diagnostics that rewrite the measured path; the current runner has no mutual-exclusion guard (recommended but not implemented in 100ef1a), so the exclusion is enforced here operationally

main_command.wrapper_semantics: unshare --net --ipc --mount --propagation private, then exec python3 -B <repo>/tools/run_joint_flight.py run <args>; sources the frozen ROS/DDS setup files; see tools/run-joint-flight.sh

timeout.semantics: GNU timeout without --foreground places the wrapper chain in its own new process group and signals that group only; the runner installs SIGTERM -> InterruptedError so its finally runs finalize_perf_capture then cleanup_children; flight children live in separate sessions (start_new_session=True) and are never in the timeout group; KILL after 120 s reaches only that same own PGID
timeout.escalation: if the runner does not exit after KILL, re-verify each child identity (pid+pgid+start_ticks) against live/children-start.json and signal only those recorded own PGIDs; never scan or signal anything else; then re-run the two-distro process scan

main_command.async_model_evidence_rationale: matches the standing main decision for this diagnostic family (docs/plan/33-rate-next-diagnostic-20260912.md section 4.3; launches xtj8wk8i and nqyqcagl); the parser accepts both forms, but this runbook fixes one canonical argv
main_command.forbidden_flags_reason: the MIXED CLI branch rejects alternate probes and other manifest families (run_joint_flight.py lines 1214-1220); --manager-gc-freeze/--early-work-timing/--owned-scheduling-snapshot existed only in the retired private runner and do not exist in this runner

2. only then tools/audit_mixed_control.py <archive>, so its evidence_sha256 seals perf-decoded.json (audit reads every file under the archive root)
3. never write perf-decoded.json or any derived value back into result.json
post_run.post_run_sweep: re-run the two-distro process scan (found must be [] and boot_id unchanged), and confirm every recorded child PGID empty; the runner already records children.*.remaining_group_members

failure_classification.precondition_failed: precheck found non-empty, boot_id mismatch, freshness > 60 s, candidate HEAD lacks c3d4916, any manifest/library/source SHA mismatch - do not launch; no run exists
failure_classification.admission_failed: mixed_admission.ok=false; run failed before children; marker stays requested/failed; not measured
failure_classification.capture_construct_failed: PerfStreamCapture constructor raised (kernel, library path/SHA, pre-existing outputs); fail-closed; not measured
failure_classification.capture_start_failed: start() nonzero or invalid handle; marker failed at finalize; not measured
failure_classification.latched_no_window: RateUnmet before close_segment('completed'): rate.last_summary is null, finalize fails closed ('lacks a completed MIXED rate segment'); raw/meta exist, no perf-windows.json; consumer without --windows is inspection-only; the complete-window measurement did not happen; latch is a legitimate diagnostic outcome, not a regression
failure_classification.sealed: marker status sealed_for_external_consumer with outputs; run the strict consumer
failure_classification.consumer_rejected: exit 3 with the reason taxonomy above; capture invalid as complete evidence; preserve all bytes, never retry over the same output name
failure_classification.consumer_io_error: exit 4; fix the path problem; never delete evidence
failure_classification.timeout_path: TERM at 1500 s -> runner finally cleans up (status failed with InterruptedError); KILL after 120 s only to the own timeout PGID; then identity-verified per-child PGID sweep and two-distro rescan

expected_absent_artifacts: perf-decoded.json inside result.json (decode is post-run only)
